digest.component_or_area: live external integration tests for Jira bridge multi-project scenarios
propositions: Live Cloud rehearsal against shared REB+DIG projects exposed that non-existent project keys cause parse errors and abort the entire pass, whereas the fake transport had masked this by returning empty results for unmapped projects.
The two shared production Cloud projects are insufficient to model three repo configurations, an empty project, and an unknown-project fail-closed path, requiring isolated throwaway projects.

A preview-gated dry-run strategy must enforce that each mutating scenario's previewed mutations target only the intended project with empty intersection against all other configured projects before sync executes.

Session-scoped fixture provisioning creates four random RBJ-prefixed scratch projects via hardened template, verifies capabilities, executes scenarios with contamination guards, and deletes all projects on every exit path including mid-run failures.

Scenarios must verify cross-project isolation: inbound tickets from multiple projects ingest correctly with source project recorded, outbound updates target only their intended project, and unknown project keys fail closed without mutation.
